objects.name: Chipkin Example B-GW
objects.note: THE GATEWAY device, both modes; vendor 389 (Chipkin Automation Systems); instance configurable with --deviceID. --mode eo: its Object_List is itself, Network Port 1 and the nine mapped objects below (11). --mode vn: itself and Network Ports 1 and 2 (3). The stack rows are device-wide facts only the stack knows - the protocol version and revision it implements, the services and object types it was configured with, the live object list and address-binding table. The accepted rows are the stack's configured defaults for APDU limits, segmentation, system status and database revision; an application that answered them from its own constants could contradict the stack, so this example does not

objects.name: Vermilion
objects.note: the GATEWAY's BACnet/IP port, both modes. Network_Number is NOT configured (0/unknown). Network_Type/Protocol_Level are set from BACnetStack_AddNetworkPortObject()'s arguments at start-up; Changes_Pending is computed and answered natively. Reliability has no fault condition this example detects, so it is accepted at the generic default

objects.name: Bronze
objects.note: --mode eo, on the GATEWAY (389019): instance n is slave unit n, named with the colour and n for n > 1 (one entry stands for instances 1-3). Reads input register 0 of its slave (measured temperature, C x 10). REAL, degrees Celsius; Present_Value is the gateway's cached value from the last poll, still served while the slave is offline. Reliability is no-fault-detected, or communication-failure while the slave is offline - the stack builds Status_Flags (FAULT) from it. Event_State reads normal (no intrinsic alarming)

objects.name: Chartreuse
objects.note: --mode eo, on the GATEWAY (389019): instance n is slave unit n, named with the colour and n for n > 1 (one entry stands for instances 1-3). Writes holding register 0 of its slave (setpoint, C x 10). Commandable via a 16-slot Priority_Array (Annex H.2.1.3); Present_Value/Priority_Array/Current_Command_Priority are resolved by the stack from the slots the app serves through GetPropertyReal/GetPropertyBool. The winning value is written through to the register (write caching, Annex H.2.1.1). Relinquish_Default 65.0 / 13.0 / 7.0 for units 1 / 2 / 3

objects.name: Fuchsia
objects.note: --mode eo, on the GATEWAY (389019): instance n is slave unit n, named with the colour and n for n > 1 (one entry stands for instances 1-3). Writes coil 0 of its slave (enable). Commandable via a 16-slot Priority_Array; Present_Value/Priority_Array/Current_Command_Priority are resolved by the stack from the slots the app serves through GetPropertyEnumerated/GetPropertyBool; the winning value is written through to the coil. Relinquish_Default active / active / inactive for units 1 / 2 / 3

objects.name: Vermilion 2
objects.note: --mode vn only, on the GATEWAY: the port to virtual network 100, created and populated by BACnetStack_AddVirtualNetwork() (Network_Type virtual, Network_Number 100, quality configured). The app serves only its Object_Name and Out_Of_Service

objects.name: Chipkin Example B-GW (Boiler)
objects.note: --mode vn only: one VIRTUAL device per slave on virtual network 100 - 389119 "Chipkin Example B-GW (Boiler)", 389120 "... (Air Handler)", 389121 "... (Chiller)" (one entry stands for the three). Added with BACnetStack_AddDeviceToVirtualNetwork; instances fixed (not moved by --deviceID). Its Object_List is itself, the three mapped objects below and its own stack-created Network Port (5). Reached through the gateway with DNET 100, DADR = the 3-octet instance. While its slave is offline it does not answer Who-Is/Who-Has (Annex H.2.2.1); its reads are still answered (a stack gap - README Known gaps). The stack and accepted rows are as for the gateway
